query: Describe the national (federal) government structure of Mexico as of 2026-11-14. For each body in the executive, legislative and judicial branches, plus the national electoral authority, list its offices with: English and local-language title, how the OFFICE is filled (direct_election, indirect_election, appointment, mixed, hereditary, ex_officio), number of seats, term length, and the CURRENT holder(s) for single-seat or leadership offices only (head of state/government, presiding officer of each legislative chamber, president of the highest court, head of the electoral authority) with party and term start/end. For multi-member bodies give seat counts and selection method but do not list every member. Note recent reforms that changed how offices are filled (for example judicial elections). Also list the subnational tiers of government (first-level divisions, and municipal/local government) with counts. Give source URLs for every current officeholder.

offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos
offices.selection_details: Direct nationwide popular election, single six-year term, no reelection.

offices.title_local: Titular de Secretaría de Estado
offices.selection_details: Heads of the 21 secretariats listed in Article 26 of the Organic Law; appointed/removed by the President, with constitutional exceptions to confirmation.

offices.title_en: Head of the Agency for Digital Transformation and Telecommunications
offices.title_local: Titular de la Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones
offices.selection_details: Executive agency listed separately from the 21 secretariats in Article 26; presidential appointment.

bodies.description: The President is both head of state and head of government; executive departments are presidentially headed.

offices.title_local: Diputada o Diputado
offices.selection_details: 300 elected in single-member districts by relative majority; 200 elected by proportional representation in five multi-member constituencies.

offices.title_en: President of the Chamber of Deputies
offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente de la Mesa Directiva de la Cámara de Diputados
offices.selection_details: Elected by deputies to preside over the chamber for a legislative year.

bodies.description: Lower chamber of the bicameral Congress of the Union.

offices.title_local: Senadora o Senador
offices.selection_details: 64 elected by relative majority (two per state/federal entity), 32 by first-minority allocation (one per entity), and 32 by nationwide proportional representation.

offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente de la Mesa Directiva del Senado de la República
offices.selection_details: Elected from among senators by absolute majority of members present, by ballot; serves one legislative year.

bodies.description: Upper chamber of the Congress of the Union.

bodies.name_en: Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation

offices.title_local: Ministra o Ministro de la Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación
offices.selection_details: Nationwide direct, secret popular vote; ordinary twelve-year nonrenewable term. The first elected cohort beginning 2025 has transitional eight- and eleven-year terms.

offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente de la Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación
offices.selection_details: Rotates every two years among elected justices by number of popular votes received.

bodies.name_local: Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación
bodies.description: Highest constitutional court; since the 2024 reform, nine justices sitting in plenary rather than two chambers.

offices.title_local: Magistrada o Magistrado Electoral de la Sala Superior
offices.selection_details: Nationwide direct popular vote; ordinary six-year nonrenewable term, subject to transitional rules for sitting and newly elected magistrates.

offices.title_local: Magistrada o Magistrado Electoral de las Salas Regionales
offices.selection_details: Five regional chambers of three; direct popular election by electoral constituency. The 2025 elected cohort is reported by the tribunal for 2025–2033 under transitional provisions.

offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente del Tribunal Electoral
offices.selection_details: Presidency rotates according to popular vote ranking under reformed Constitution Article 99; not the president of the Supreme Court.

bodies.name_local: Tribunal Electoral del Poder Judicial de la Federación
bodies.description: Specialized federal electoral court, within the judiciary, distinct from the autonomous INE.

offices.title_local: Magistrada o Magistrado del Tribunal de Disciplina Judicial
offices.selection_details: Direct nationwide popular vote; staggered, nonrenewable six-year terms.

offices.title_en: President of the Judicial Discipline Tribunal
offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente del Tribunal de Disciplina Judicial
offices.selection_details: Two-year rotation according to votes won in the popular judicial election.

bodies.description: Independent federal judicial disciplinary body created by the 2024 reform.

offices.title_en: Member of the Judicial Administration Body
offices.title_local: Integrante del Pleno del Órgano de Administración Judicial
offices.selection_details: One designated by the President, one by a two-thirds vote of senators present, and three by six Supreme Court votes.

offices.title_en: President of the Judicial Administration Body
offices.title_local: Presidenta o Presidente del Órgano de Administración Judicial
offices.selection_details: Rotating two-year leadership from among its five appointed members, under applicable law.

bodies.description: Administers the federal judiciary and judicial career, separately from the discipline tribunal.

bodies.name_en: Federal circuit courts and district courts

offices.title_local: Magistrada o Magistrado de Circuito
offices.selection_details: Direct popular election within judicial circuits; renewable for consecutive nine-year terms. 464 posts were contested in 2025, not the systemwide total.

offices.title_local: Jueza o Juez de Distrito
offices.selection_details: Direct popular election within judicial circuits; renewable for consecutive nine-year terms. 386 posts were contested in 2025, not the systemwide total.

bodies.name_local: Tribunales de Circuito y Juzgados de Distrito
bodies.description: Circuit appellate and collegiate courts and first-instance district courts; total authorized seats vary and are determined by the Judicial Administration Body. The 2025 election filled 464 circuit and 386 district posts, not their total seat counts.

offices.title_local: Consejera o Consejero Electoral
offices.selection_details: Chosen by two-thirds of deputies present via constitutionally specified selection procedure; staggered nine-year nonrenewable terms.

offices.title_local: Consejera Presidenta o Consejero Presidente del Consejo General
offices.selection_details: Ordinarily chosen by two-thirds of deputies present for a nonrenewable nine-year term; on a definitive vacancy, councillors internally elect a provisional president until the Chamber selects a replacement.

bodies.description: Constitutionally autonomous national election administrator; the Council has 11 voting electoral councillor positions, including the presidency. Legislative and party representatives and the executive secretary attend without vote.

subnational_levels.description: 31 states and Mexico City, together called entidades federativas.
Local governments of the states; Mexico City instead has 16 territorial boroughs (alcaldías).

subnational_levels.name_local: Demarcaciones territoriales (alcaldías) de la Ciudad de México
subnational_levels.description: Mexico City local-government units; 2,478 municipalities plus boroughs nationwide.
